newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: At least 20 killed in Pakistani bus crash.
newsitem.headline: At least 20 killed in Pakistani bus crash.

text.p: At least 20 people were killed when a bus plunged into a ravine at Lotor in northern Pakistan on Saturday, the official news agency APP reported.
It said the bus was travelling from Skardu, about 290 km (180 miles) northeast of Islamabad, to the Pakistani capital's sister city Rawalpindi with 21 passengers on board.
More passengers boarded the bus en route and APP said the death toll could rise. It had no word on the number of injured in the accident.
